name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €84/MWh on 16 Nov, above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route restricted
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €84/MWh on 16 Nov, 0.8% lower on the week and 33% higher over three months, 19% below its 52-week high of €104 and well above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Its largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 6.8%. Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed tanker mine strikes on 15–16 Nov (Times of Israel).
for_you: Wholesale gas prices this high tend to feed into household energy bills when price caps are next reset, and into costs for energy-intensive businesses.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
